messages:
samira_eng: trying to onboard our infra team to Redwood Private. running into TLS verify failures only on async calls. sync Client(..., ca_bundle="/etc/ssl/certs/company-ca.pem") works but async raises SSLError.
samira_eng: base_url is https://inference.private.local:8443 and we also route through a corporate proxy.

tina_sdk: which SDK version? are you using httpx or aiohttp async backend?
samira_eng: 0.12.1, httpx.

tina_sdk: known issue in early 0.12.x where async pooled connectors didn't carry over custom ssl contexts. quick workaround: set SSL_CERT_FILE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE env vars to your CA path, or disable pool reuse in httpx transport.

samira_eng: can you share the transport snippet? we prefer not to set global envs.

tina_sdk: sure:
```py
import httpx
from redwood import Client
transport = httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport(retries=2, trust_env=True, limits=None)
client = Client(api_key='KEY', base_url='https://inference.private.local:8443', ca_bundle='/etc/ssl/certs/company-ca.pem', _httpx_transport=transport)
```
this forces httpx to honor your ca_bundle path at the transport layer.

nate_platform: note: if you're behind an authenticated proxy, ensure HTTPS_PROXY contains credentials (http://user:pass@proxy:3128). our envoy also expects the /api prefix on the base_url.

samira_eng: we tried proxy env + transport but kept seeing 407 during retries. looks like proxy auth header isn't preserved across backoff.

tina_sdk: we fixed proxy auth propagation and CA propagation in 0.13.0-alpha. please try the rc if you can. release notes mention: async CA propagation, proxy-auth preserved on retries, and explicit verify kw for async Client.

yara_support: verified with a customer earlier: set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and update to 0.13.0rc, resolved both SSL and proxy 407s. opening docs PR with examples for Dedicated/Private: base_url patterns, env var fallbacks, proxy examples for httpx/aiohttp.

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy of SDK docs patch and runtime change for 0.13.0rc 2025-04-02T04:00:00Z

samira_eng: installed rc  async + proxy auth fixed. two suggestions: (1) add clear example for corporate proxies with basic auth in docs, (2) include a small troubleshooting checklist (curl --cacert, env var overrides, verify host/port/path).

tina_sdk: great suggestions  i'll add both to the PR and link you for review. closing this thread once docs PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
